comparable_cases.why_comparable: Formula retail bank branch at 2257 Irving St (132 m away), approved October 2022 after an 11-month use decision process. Only successful formula retail CUA found in the Irving NCD in recent years, showing that formula retail can be approved but faces a lengthy discretionary process.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Use decision: Approved with 20 conditions including standard validity (3-year window), community liaison, lighting controls, signage program review, and noise mitigation. The case took 11 months from filing to approval (341 days for an approved use decision). A bank is a Financial Service use, not a restaurant, so the Commission's findings may not translate directly to food retail, but it confirm…

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Small self-service bakery/cafe at 2227-2229 Irving St (104 m away), same NCD-IRVING zoning, denied December 1992. One of the only denied cafe applications found on the corridor, providing a cautionary data point.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Use decision: Denied after a 78-day process. The description states it was a small self-service restaurant and bakery. The records do not state the reason for denial. This was filed under old Planning Code provisions (referenced 'fast food' rules per §781.2), so the regulatory framework has changed, but it shows that cafe concepts in the Irving NCD are not automatically approved even when the use…

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Fast-food ice cream/dessert establishment at 2123 Irving St (immediately next door to the subject site), approved October 1985 via CUA. A cafe use decision on the same block, though under the older NC-2 zoning rules before the Irving NCD was codified.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Use decision: Approved with a 41-day timeline. This was a fast-food dessert shop (ice cream), a direct analog to a boba cafe. It required a CUA under the old rules; today limited restaurants are principally permitted in the Irving NCD, so the discretionary hurdle is lower unless formula retail is involved.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Small self-service coffee shop at 1914-1920 Irving St (200 m away), approved February 1995 via CUA. Another cafe concept requiring conditional use under the older Irving Street sub-district rules.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Use decision: Approved with a 57-day timeline. Under the NC-2 district rules in effect in 1995, small self-service restaurants required conditional use authorization. The current Irving NCD rules (§732) make limited restaurants principally permitted, removing this hurdle for non-formula retail operators.

filing_playbook.what_to_say: Submit a zoning determination request describing the concept as a formula retail cafe with 11 other locations, standardized branding, signage, interior design, uniforms, menu presentation, and limited food preparation. Cite Planning Code § 732 and ask whether the concept is permitted by right, requires Conditional Use Authorization under § 303.1, or is prohibited. Reference the two cancelled formula retail CUA applications at 2126 and 2130 Irving St and the 2021 health referral for The Mochi Donut Shop stating that formula retail use is not permitted in the Irving NCD. Request a written answer before proceeding with lease negotiations.

timeline_cost.notes: No timeline or cost range is given because zoning does not permit the concept as described at this address. Planning Code § 732 states that formula retail is not permitted for Limited Restaurant use in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District. Two formula retail limited restaurant Conditional Use Authorization applications on this block (The Mochi Donut Shop at 2126 Irving and Krispy Krunchy Chicken at 2130 Irving) were cancelled in 2021–2022 without reaching a Planning Commission hearing; the records do not state why they were cancelled. Planning staff stated in a 2021 health referral for The Mochi Donut Shop that formula retail use is not permitted in the Irving NCD and that while standardized merchandise is allowed, additional standardized features (branding, decor, facade treatments) would not be permitted without Conditional Use Authorization approval, which was never obtained. Obtain a written zoning determination from San Francisco Planning before filing any application or signing a lease.
timeline_cost.path: No approval path: zoning does not permit the concept as described at this address.

records_summary: 2127 Irving St sits in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District (NCD-IRVING), where limited restaurants are principally permitted under Planning Code §732. The address had a limited restaurant (Sip Tea 1011 SF) approved in 2019 as a change of use from a prior food establishment, exempted from Section 312/311 neighborhood notice. The block is densely developed with food and drink businesses: 22 registered establishments within 500 feet and 4 active ABC Type 41 licenses within 500 feet. The site is also within the Family and Senior Housing Opportunity Special Use District, which governs housing but does not restrict restaurant uses. Too few comparable use decisions exist nearby in the last 10 years to calculate an approval rate (N=0 dated use decisions within 1,000 ft).
data_gaps: The pathway analysis states whether the existing use continues is 'not decided by the rules'—the records do not confirm whether Sip Tea 1011 SF is still operating at 2127 Irving St
The base rate shows N=0 comparable dated use decisions within 1,000 ft in the last 10 years, so no statistical approval rate can be calculated
ABC does not publish conditions on Type 41 licenses, so undue-concentration findings or operating restrictions at neighboring premises are unknown
The 2019 approval for Sip Tea 1011 SF lists no conditions and was exempted from neighborhood notice, so community response is not documented
